title: Record 15-sec demo video for launch tweet
description:
Shot list is in LAUNCH.md (gitignored, local-only). Key beats:
- terminal scrolling output
- close lid (filmed externally with phone)
- walk a few feet
- re-open lid, terminal still scrolling
- type nosleep --off

Output: MP4 under 5MB for Twitter, animated GIF under 5MB for README. Upload as a GitHub release asset and link from README.

title: Submit nosleep to homebrew-core once at 75+ stars / 30 forks
description:
Homebrew-core acceptance thresholds (as of 2026): ~75 stars and 30+ forks for new submissions. Once we hit those, submit so users can ==> Fetching downloads for: nosleep
==> Installing nosleep from tmad4000/nosleep without the tap namespace.

When this lands:
- Add a deprecation banner to homebrew-nosleep README pointing at homebrew-core
- Update nosleep README install section to lead with bare ==> Fetching downloads for: nosleep
==> Installing nosleep from tmad4000/nosleep
- Eventually archive tmad4000/homebrew-nosleep

See RELEASING.md 'Homebrew-core submission' section for the procedure.

title: v1.1 follow-up release ~1 week post-launch
description:
Plan one small follow-up release based on user feedback from launch. Common candidates:

- Display sleep too (combine with caffeinate -d)
- Notification when timed mode finishes
- Configurable install path (not just /usr/local/bin)
- Linux port (separate flag-compatible wrapper around systemd-inhibit)

Doubles the half-life of the launch. Tweet a 'new in v1.1' update with the same audience.

title: Launch on X and Show HN
description:
Reactive launch tied to the May 13 2026 Business Insider piece. Copy is in LAUNCH.md (gitignored). Timing: tweet first, Show HN post ~2h later. Day 0 is the BI article day. After that the news hook decays fast.

Depends on: brew install verified, demo video recorded.

title: Verify brew install works on a clean Mac before launch tweet
description:
Local test hit an Xcode Command Line Tools warning that obscured whether the brew install actually completed. Need to verify on a clean Mac (or after fixing local CLT) that:

1. brew tap tmad4000/nosleep
2. brew install tmad4000/nosleep/nosleep
3. nosleep --version prints 1.0.0
4. nosleep --setup writes /etc/sudoers.d/pmset
5. nosleep --status works
6. nosleep --uninstall fully reverses install

BLOCKER for the launch tweet. If brew install is broken for end users, the tweet falls flat.

title: dev.to writeup 3 days post-launch
description:
Longer-form post for search-traffic retention. Title: 'I open-sourced the 50-line bash script for keeping your Mac running with the lid closed.' Includes the BI framing, the caffeinate-doesn't-work explainer, and the sudoers safety story.

Post 3 days after the launch tweet — captures readers who found the GitHub link but want context, plus SEO long-tail.
